name: Creavi Appointment Booking Calendar
author: Creavi

sections.description:
Creavi is a beautiful, free WordPress appointment booking plugin for service businesses. Let customers choose a service, select a specialist, and book an available time on your website. Connect Google Calendar, Outlook, or calendars from Nextcloud, MXroute and other providers that support CalDAV. Built-in secure video conferencing, editable email designs and reminders, shared staff schedules, and booking approval are included, with no plugin-imposed service or booking limits.

Use a booking button, an embedded calendar, or a Service Catalog with categories and provider selection. Suitable for salons, clinics, consultants, coaches, personal trainers, fitness studios, and yoga instructors.

Try the live booking demo | Read the documentation | Ask a support question

Features

Booking and service catalogs

  • Guided setup: Create a service through Service, Availability, Display and Notifications. Save & exit lets you continue later.
  • Booking display: Embed a calendar on your page or open it from a booking button.
  • Service catalogs: Show a simple service list or categories with optional images and your own labels.
  • Provider selection: Let customers choose a specialist and see times that fit the selected service.
  • Meeting options: Offer in-person, phone or online appointments, with your own meeting link or a generated secure video meeting.

Availability, durations and staff schedules

  • Appointment lengths: Choose a 10, 15, 20, 30, 60 or 90-minute preset, or a Custom duration from 1 minute to 24 hours.
  • Linked start and end times: Set the duration or time range, including overnight appointments. Add a booking label such as “Full day” or “Band rehearsal.”
  • Schedule rules: Set weekday hours, individual bookable dates, days off, minimum notice and breaks between appointments.
  • Booking windows: Offer rolling availability in days or months, or up to 10 years ahead.
  • Shared staff calendars: Link several services to one staff schedule so a booking blocks overlapping times across those services.
  • Timezones and format: Show visitor-local or fixed business times in 12 or 24-hour format. Full-day appointments show a start/end range.
  • Start-time grid: A live summary shows duration, break and start-time spacing. Changing duration, break or first start clears the grid selections so you can choose starts again.

Calendar connections: Google, Outlook, Nextcloud and MXroute

CalDAV is a standard way for apps to connect to online calendars. It lets Creavi connect to calendars hosted by Nextcloud, MXroute and other compatible providers.

  • Google Calendar and Outlook: Add confirmed appointments to your connected calendar and block times already marked busy.
  • Nextcloud, MXroute and other CalDAV calendars: Connect your calendar account, find its calendars and choose which ones to use for availability and booking events.
  • Busy-time checks: Select the calendars that should prevent overlapping appointments.
  • Booking updates: Synchronize confirmed appointments, rescheduling and cancellations with the selected booking calendar.
  • Event details: Customize event titles and descriptions with customer details, the appointment location or meeting link.
  • Connection management: Manage providers in one Calendar integration section, choose connections per service or shared staff calendar, and store CalDAV login details encrypted on your WordPress site.

Calendar appearance and layouts

  • Booking layouts: Choose Two columns for service details beside the calendar, or Single column for a calendar-focused block.
  • Single-column arrangements: Keep the calendar above the times, use a wider calendar with one scrollable row of times, or place the calendar on the left and one vertical column of times on the right.
  • Responsive sizing: Narrow blocks stack the calendar and times to keep the booking flow usable.
  • Optional labels: Hide Select date, Select time, Duration or Enter your details. Hiding Select time also hides its globe; hiding Duration keeps the appointment length visible.
  • Visible defaults: Every Hide switch starts off, including after an upgrade. Required form and navigation labels remain visible.
  • Themes and wording: Preview Light, Dark and Glass themes, accent colours, editable labels and calendar languages beside a live preview.
  • Theme compatibility: Scoped styles protect calendar year inputs, day cells, borders and controls from unwanted theme or page-builder styles. Existing services keep their saved layout and wording.

Booking forms and appointment management

  • Configurable forms: Collect contact details, custom answers and consent, including number and date fields.
  • Automatic or manual approval: Choose the approval mode separately for each service. Pending requests reserve their time until approved or rejected.
  • Booking actions: Approve or reject requests from the booking list or individual booking screen.
  • Rescheduling and cancellation: Review changes to upcoming appointments and choose customer notifications.
  • Exports and retention: Export selected bookings to CSV or Excel and choose an optional retention period for old records.

Email designs and reminders

  • Three email layouts: Choose Minimal, Branded or Card.
  • Shared branding: Set your business name, logo, accent colour, footer and optional booking-details accent line.
  • Visual editing: Edit subjects and wording, add paragraphs before or after booking details, and insert replacement tags while automatic dates, times and locations stay protected.
  • Four message types: Customize customer confirmation, admin confirmation, customer reminder and admin reminder, with Desktop/Mobile previews and test emails.
  • Separate reminders: Configure customer and admin reminder schedules independently.
  • Appointment details: Include calendar attachments and the appropriate customer or host meeting link, address or phone details in booking-change emails.
  • Existing templates: Keep your custom wording and templates. Choosing a new design is optional; upgrades do not automatically replace saved custom emails.

Elementor demos and WordPress integration

  • Nine editable demo pages: Start with designs for salons, yoga studios, dental clinics, consultants, coaches and sales demos, including Instagram Brand Consultant. More demos are coming soon.
  • Draft imports: Import pages with bundled images, services and catalogs, then set real content and availability before publishing.
  • Reuse your service: Add the service you published in guided setup to a demo page while keeping its availability and booking settings.
  • Elementor setup: The import flow can install and activate free Elementor if needed. Demo designs require V4 atomic elements and global classes.
  • Builder support: Use booking shortcodes with the block editor, Elementor and other builders. Booking Profile and Service Hero blocks are included; regular shortcodes work without Elementor.
  • Optional integrations: Connect approved tools through restricted REST API or MCP connections.

Add booking to your existing website

  • Inline calendar: [creavibc_booking_inline id="123"]
  • Popup booking button: [creavibc_booking_button id="123"]
  • Service Catalog: [creavibc_service_catalog id="123"]

Replace 123 with the service or catalog ID. Shortcodes work with the block editor, Elementor, and other builders. Booking Profile and Service Hero blocks are also included.

Offer in-person, phone, or online appointments with your own meeting link or a generated video meeting.

Creavi email updates in guided setup

After publishing, guided setup offers another service, Service Catalog, editable demo pages, booking preview and tailored-page help. Email updates are optional: choose Skip to finish without subscribing, or enter your email, check the consent box and select Allow & continue. The checkbox starts unchecked. If signup fails, retry or skip; the service you already published stays available.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin in WordPress.
  2. Open Creavi Booking → Service setup and follow Service, Availability, Display and Notifications. Choose a duration and meeting type, set availability or use an existing staff calendar, then publish. Skip the optional email signup or subscribe with consent. All Services → Add New opens the full editor.
  3. Add its shortcode to a page, or create a Service Catalog for multiple services.
  4. Optionally connect calendars, configure reminders, or import an Elementor demo page.
  5. Preview the page and make a test booking.
sections.faq:
When does guided setup open automatically?

On a fresh installation, setup opens after an administrator individually activates the plugin with no saved services. It does not interrupt plugin updates, bulk or network activation, or repeat activation after the first prompt. Existing services, including drafts, prevent the automatic opening. You can always open Creavi Booking → Service setup manually.

Can I leave setup and continue later?

Yes. Continue, Back, and Save & exit save setup progress for your WordPress account. Publishing creates a regular service; copy its shortcode into an existing page. You can then use the full service editor for individual start times, forms, emails and calendar connections. Publishing a service does not create or publish a website page.

Can I open service setup again after finishing?

Yes. Creavi Booking → Service setup stays available after the first run. Opening it after finishing starts the normal wizard for another service. Unfinished setup resumes where you left it, including the optional email-updates screen after publication. Opening setup does not create a service; Publish service does.

Do I need to subscribe to finish setup?

No. Select Skip on the Email updates screen to finish without subscribing. Booking notifications, calendars and the published service work independently of this optional subscription.

Can I use appointments longer than 90 minutes or offer one fixed time per day?

Yes. Open a service, go to Available time → Appointment duration → Custom, and set hours and minutes or linked First start time and End time. Durations range from 1 minute to 24 hours, including overnight appointments. An optional booking label can describe a rehearsal, full day or another service. Select the bookable dates in Available days and offer just one start per applicable weekday for a fixed daily appointment. Changing duration, break or first start clears the weekly grid selections; choose your starts again before saving.

Where can I change the calendar layout or hide headings?

Open the service and go to Calendar design. Choose Booking layout → Single column to show Calendar arrangement: Calendar above · times below, Wide calendar · one row of times, or Calendar left · times right. The right-hand time slots form one vertical column; narrow blocks stack the calendar and times. In Text & Labels, use Hide beside optional labels. All switches start off. Required form labels, Back and Next remain visible. Save the service to apply these choices to both the website and popup.

Is Creavi appointment booking free?

Yes. Calendar connections, staff schedules, reminders, approval, exports, and demos are included. There are no plugin-imposed service or booking limits; capacity depends on your hosting. Website, email, and calendar providers remain separate services.

Does it sync with Google Calendar and Outlook?

Yes. Connected calendars can receive booking events and block busy times. Google and Outlook sync is included without a separate Creavi calendar-sync subscription.

Can one staff member offer several services without double bookings?

Yes. Connect those services to the same staff calendar. Its shared availability, existing appointments, and buffer settings are used across the linked services to prevent overlaps.

Can I connect Nextcloud, MXroute or another calendar provider?

Yes. Nextcloud and MXroute connect through CalDAV, the calendar connection standard supported by Creavi. You can also connect other providers that offer a compatible CalDAV calendar. Provider setup guides: Nextcloud and MXroute.

Open Creavi Booking > CalDAV calendars, enter the host’s HTTPS address and calendar credentials, find the calendars, and choose which calendars block busy times and which receives confirmed bookings. Assign the connection to a service or shared staff calendar. MXroute uses mailbox credentials; Nextcloud supports app passwords. Connection credentials are stored encrypted on your WordPress site. If a selected calendar cannot be checked, booking confirmation pauses for affected services. Calendar write failures keep the WordPress booking and offer retry/review. Manage booking changes in Creavi; external edits are protected from being overwritten during updates.

CalDAV requests go directly from your WordPress server to the calendar host you configure. The host receives calendar-read requests and, when enabled, booking events containing the service name, booking reference and booking times. Its own terms and privacy policy apply. Google and Outlook connections are independent of CalDAV.

Do I need Elementor to use the plugin?

No. Booking buttons, inline calendars, and Service Catalog shortcodes work without Elementor. The nine imported demo page designs require Elementor with V4 atomic elements and global classes enabled.

Can I approve, reschedule, or cancel bookings?

Yes. Manual approval lets you review requests while their slots stay reserved. Approve or reject pending requests, or reschedule and cancel upcoming confirmed appointments with optional customer notifications.

Can customers book in their own timezone?

Yes. Choose visitor-local or fixed business timezones, with 12 or 24-hour display. Calendars support the website language and 67 regional choices. Labels are editable per service.

Can I customise the booking form and emails?

Yes. Edit contact, consent, and custom fields, including number and date questions. In the service’s Notifications section, choose Minimal, Branded or Card, adjust branding, and edit customer/admin confirmation and reminder emails in the live preview. Subjects and templates support placeholders such as {name}, {service}, {date}, and {time}. Existing templates remain unchanged until you choose to edit or redesign them.

Are automated appointment reminders included?

Yes. Customer and admin reminders have separate schedules and templates. They use WordPress mail and scheduled tasks; quiet sites should use regular server-triggered WordPress Cron for timely reminders.

Can I connect an AI assistant?

Yes, through optional restricted REST API and MCP connections. The native owner MCP connection requires WordPress 6.9 or later and the official MCP Adapter 0.6.1 or later. Customer booking requires HTTPS, selected public services, and a supported AI host.
sections.changelog:
1.9.0

  • Added guided service setup with Service, Availability, Display and Notifications steps, saved progress, staff-calendar selection, meeting options, shortcode copying and booking preview. Setup opens once on a fresh individual activation with no saved services and remains available from the menu.
  • Added optional Creavi email updates with unchecked consent, Skip, verified signup status, retry and unsubscribe. Publishing and booking work independently of subscribing.
  • Added post-publication actions for another service, Service Catalog, editable Elementor demo pages and tailored-page help. Demo imports can reuse the published service without replacing its availability or booking settings.
  • Added direct CalDAV connections, calendar discovery, busy-time checks, and confirmed booking event creation, rescheduling and cancellation, with editable event details.
  • Added encrypted CalDAV credentials, selected busy calendars, booking destinations, delivery retry/review feedback and protection for externally edited calendar events.
  • Unified Google, Outlook and CalDAV settings in Calendar integration, with service-level calendar selection, booking event controls and clearer connection/busy-check feedback.
  • Added custom appointment durations from 1 minute to 24 hours, linked start/end controls, optional booking labels, and rolling booking windows up to 10 years. The original six duration presets remain available.
  • Refined the weekly start-time grid, duration and break controls, compact customer slots, full-day time ranges, and time format settings. Grid changes clear start selections and show a reminder to choose them again.
  • Added Single column calendar arrangements: calendar above times, wider calendar with one scrollable time row, or calendar left with a vertical time column on the right. Narrow blocks adapt to a stacked layout; Two columns keeps its existing layout.
  • Added aligned Hide switches beside optional Select date, Select time, Duration and Enter your details labels. All switches default to off, including on existing installations. Hiding Select time also hides its globe; required form and navigation labels stay visible.
  • Protected calendar year inputs, day cells, borders and controls against unwanted theme and page-builder styles, with matching frontend and admin previews.
  • Added Minimal, Branded and Card email layouts with shared branding, logo sizing, colours, footer and an optional booking-details accent line.
  • Added inline email wording and subject editing, positioned paragraphs, replacement-tag hints, Desktop/Mobile previews and test emails for customer/admin confirmations and reminders. Existing custom templates remain supported.
  • Improved reschedule emails with the customer’s saved meeting link, address or phone details, the host’s own call link, a customer preview and one editable message. Removed the previous appointment block and separate reason field from these emails.
  • Improved expandable event details, service navigation icons, hover states and booking menu order.
  • Fixed edited widget and Custom duration labels losing literal backslashes. Preserved existing shortcodes, saved settings, schedules, email wording and booking duration snapshots when upgrading from 1.8.1.

1.8.1

  • Fixed secure video appointments retaining the original call time after rescheduling. A new meeting is created with the updated time and booked duration.
  • Send the new customer and host call links in their respective notifications and calendar attachments. Customer notification is required when rescheduling secure video calls.
  • Keep the original appointment unchanged if the video meeting cannot be created or the booking cannot be saved.

1.8.0

  • Added nine draft Elementor demo pages with images and booking content, including Instagram Brand Consultant. Requires V4 atomic elements and global classes.
  • Added per-service approval, booking-screen action buttons, reviewed rescheduling and cancellation, notifications, and change history.
  • Refined inline and popup calendars with expandable slots, thin scrollbars, soft fades, stable spacing, and improved live previews.
  • Recheck availability before approval, prevent duplicate confirmations, and flag failed calendar-event delivery. Existing shortcodes and settings remain supported.
  • Clarified demo labels and admin news button styling.

Full release notes, including the published 1.7.0 entry, are preserved in changelog.txt in the plugin download.
